method: Each section read in full by a machine-assisted reviewer against the packs and the ground catalogue as of this date; not a legal review.

sections.bearsOn: Establishes the Dome and Slim landscape units (Maps 1 and 2) as the area the objectives apply to.
Sets the Dome unit's old growth distribution, by variant, as the OGMAs on Map 1; a block meets it by leaving those OGMAs intact.
sections.gapNote: The ogma screen draws the OGMAs and the old forest module counts legal OGMAs whole toward PG TSA Objectives A and B (D.1); no rule tests that a block stays out of them (see the strategies).

sections.bearsOn: Requires the OGMAs on Map 1 to be maintained, so a block or road inside one meets the limits in 1.02 and 1.03.
sections.gapNote: The rules ask the order’s questions once the reviewer names the order; the OGMA screen still leaves harvest and road reach unknown.

sections.bearsOn: Limits cutting in an OGMA to what is absolutely necessary for insect or disease control and, where a threat to adjacent stands requires it, to keeping old-growth structure as much as possible.
sections.gapNote: The rules ask the order’s questions once the reviewer names the order; the OGMA screen still leaves harvest and road reach unknown.

sections.bearsOn: Bars road construction in an OGMA unless there is no other practicable option, and requires any temporary road there to be deactivated, rehabilitated and planted as soon as possible.
sections.gapNote: The rules ask the order’s questions once the reviewer names the order; the OGMA screen still leaves harvest and road reach unknown.

sections.bearsOn: Allows fire suppression in OGMAs to keep their integrity; it does not bear on making a block.
Sets the Slim unit's old growth distribution, by variant, as the OGMAs on Map 2; a block meets it by leaving those OGMAs intact.

Lets existing range use continue in Slim OGMAs under authorized tenures, carried out with regard to their old growth values.
sections.gapNote: The ogma screen's grazing reach is unknown; the order allows continued use with a sensitivity condition.

sections.bearsOn: Required forest development plans submitted after the effective date to be consistent; under FRPA the objectives bind through Land Act s. 93.8 and the FSP.
sections.gapNote: A document check that the FSP carries results or strategies for the OGMAs.
